title: Loops Inside Graphs: How I Structure Reliable Agent Workflows
description: Local repair loops, explicit handoffs, compatible artifacts, and durable recovery: designing parallel agent workflows without confusing diagrams with guarantees.
author: Jordan Davis
coverAlt: Two bounded worker loops join under one contract, then pass through integration checks and a separate review gate.
